notes.subject: Kristy call notes — handwritten outreach history
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten call notes list the Carson City Nevada State Fair, phone 775-400-1102, and say information was emailed and they would consider Adventure Zone next year (2027). Gmail confirms Amy emailed Lindsey in April 2026 after Kristy spoke with Sheila. This is the Carson City/Mills Park event, which is distinct from the separate state-sponsored State Fair of Nevada that returned in Reno in 2026.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: Kristy's note says the Carson City event would consider Adventure Zone next year. Reconnect early and keep it distinct from the separate official State Fair of Nevada in Reno.
